bullets.title: What if the Placebo Effect Isn’t a Trick?
bullets.note: (New York Times Magazine). This was recommended to me by [Dr. Peter Attia](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/27uk8e5mmuohezldk/opfkhqhpxe6zm/aHR0cHM6Ly9wZXRlcmF0dGlhbWQuY29tL3RpbWZlcnJpc3MvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9dGltZmVycmlzcyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPXRpbWZlcnJpc3MmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==). Here’s a good teaser from the piece: “New research is zeroing in on a biochemical basis for the placebo effect — possibly opening a Pandora’s box for Western medicine.”

bullets.title: Coda
bullets.note: Specifically, I’m playing with new versions of the [Dreamlining](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/27uk8e5mmuohezldk/6mceh8hzx45q9/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb2RhLmxpbmsvdGltZmVycmlzcy1kcmVhbWxpbmluZw==) and [Fear-setting](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/27uk8e5mmuohezldk/2ds2hoh6lx85x/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb2RhLmxpbmsvdGltZmVycmlzcy1mZWFyc2V0dGluZw==) exercises using their platform. I have no stake in the company but find it interesting. Perhaps, like [Stripe](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/27uk8e5mmuohezldk/95azhnh048xkk/aHR0cHM6Ly9zdHJpcGUuY29tLw==), it will reinvigorate a space full of incumbents?

bullets.title: My interview with the one and only, LeBron James
bullets.note: This episode of The Tim Ferriss Show was the first time that LeBron ([@KingJames](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/27uk8e5mmuohezldk/0nhwh9hvn4x0w/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9LaW5nSmFtZXM=)) has been interviewed alongside his very below-the-radar, some might say top-secret, athletic trainer about details of training, recovery, diet, and even how much longer he hopes to play in the NBA. Enjoy!
